description:
On or about 25 March 2026, Government intends to issue a solicitation for "Fort Peck Dam Mowing and Trimming". The solicitation will close on or about 8 April 2026. This solicitation will be 100% set-aside for small business. 

Project Description:
This is a non-personal services contract to provide lawn maintenance for the Fort Peck Dam Area Services include mowing and trimming and picking up any trash or tree limbs in the mowing areas designated in the Performance Work Statement. 

Period of Performance:
Base Year: May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027
Active Period: May 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026
Inactive Period: October 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027

Option Year 1: May 1, 2027 through April 30, 2028
Active Period: May 1, 2027 through September 30, 2027
Inactive Period: October 1, 2027 through April 30, 2028

Option Year 2: May 1, 2028 through April 30, 2029
Active Period: May 1, 2028 through September 30, 2028
Inactive Period: October 1, 2028 through April 30, 2029

Option Year 3: May 1, 2029 through April 30, 2030
Active Period: May 1, 2029 through September 30, 2029
Inactive Period: October 1, 2029 through April 30, 2030

Option Year 4: May 1, 2030 through April 30, 2031
Active Period: May 1, 2030 through September 30, 2030
Inactive Period: October 1, 2030 through April 30, 2031



Site Visit:
A formal Site Visit will not be scheduled; however, offerors are invited to arrange their own side vist if they would like to inspect the site where work will be performed. Information regarding who to contact to arrange for a site visit will be included in the solicitation.

NAICS Code:
The Primary North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code anticipated for solicitation is 561730 - Landscaping Services, with a size standard for small business of $9.5M.

Obtaining Solicitation Documents:
Solicitation documents will be posted to the web via SAM.gov (sam.gov). Find solicitation announcement in SAM.gov (sam.gov).
1. Use the ‘All Award Data' to locate the project by entering the solicitation number.
2. By using the ‘login' feature, it allows additional search features and allows you to keep your searches. Login might be required on some solicitations that are considered restricted.
3. Once you have located your project, click on link to solicitation to view the project. Files may be downloaded from the column on the left side reading ‘Attachments/Links’.
